name: Prune
summary: Free, local-first structural linter for AI-written TypeScript and JavaScript. Finds dead exports, unreachable files, duplicate types, god files, import cycles and near-duplicate functions, and hands cleanup to coding agents as verifiable tasks.

install.note: Per-repo devDependency; run with npx prune.

detectors.name: Dead exports
detectors.finds: Exports and whole files that nothing reachable from an entry point uses, classified as used, test_only, same_file_only, unused or unreachable.

detectors.name: God file
detectors.finds: Files whose behavior (functions, classes) outgrew one concept.

detectors.name: Import cycle
detectors.finds: Runtime value import cycles; type-only cycles are reported separately at low severity.

detectors.name: Interface sprawl
detectors.finds: Types, interfaces and object validators that restate the same fields.

detectors.name: Lexicon
detectors.finds: One shape under several names, or one name used for unrelated shapes.

detectors.name: Redundant logic
detectors.finds: Near-duplicate functions that should be consolidated.

detectors.name: Barrel bloat
detectors.finds: Index files re-exporting too many modules.

detectors.name: Over-abstraction
detectors.finds: Wrappers that only forward a call, and single-implementation interfaces.

setup.claude_code: claude mcp add prune -- npx prune mcp
setup.claude_code_binary: claude mcp add prune -- prune mcp

tools.name: tasks
tools.description: Prioritized cleanup tasks, each with files, the change, an optional autofix command, and a done-when check (prune verify <id>).

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Findings and score, most severe first. Filters: limit, min_severity, changed, use_baseline.

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Markdown refactor plan for one finding.

tools.name: compose_plan
tools.description: Structured compose/rename instructions for one finding.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Whether a finding is resolved after refactoring.

tools.name: who_uses
tools.description: Usage class of an export and every file that uses it, through barrels, namespaces and Convex references.

tools.name: safe_to_delete
tools.description: Whether deleting or un-exporting an export is safe, with reasons.

tools.name: rename_impact
tools.description: Files and edit counts a rename touches. Writes nothing.

tools.name: recent_files
tools.description: Files touched in recent git history.

commands.does: Pre-commit gate over staged files; fails only on new findings at or above --fail-on (default high).
Prioritized task list for agents. --json, -n, --min-severity, --changed, --baseline, -o FILE
Record current findings in .prune-baseline.json so only new ones fail.
Safe autofix (unexport, delete unreachable files), dry run unless --apply; each fix reverted if --check fails.
Rename an export across importers, dry run unless --apply.
Markdown refactor plan for a finding.
Exit 0 once a finding is resolved.
